svg.title: Soft Orbit / main / high contrast
svg.desc: Copilot Reel VI v1.0 vector master at the 400 DIP canvas. Values from design/vi/tokens.json; vendor marks embedded from assets/brands PNGs exactly as the runtime crops them (provenance in assets/brands/provenance.json). Accent shown with the token fallback values. High contrast uses live system colors; this master shows the illustrative High Contrast Black sample.

tspan.font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', sans-serif
